_comment: Per-well physics parameters — single source of truth for both the fleet generator (scripts/generate_fleet.py) and the simulator (app/services/simulator.py). BGW-01 values exactly match the simulator module-level constants so existing outputs are unchanged. Do not edit values to improve backtest results.

_provenance_key.generator_direct: Value taken verbatim from the WELL_PROFILES dict in scripts/generate_fleet.py
_provenance_key.generator_default: Field absent from WELL_PROFILES; generator used the module-level default — value inherited from synthetic_data_generator.py / simulator.py constants
_provenance_key.assumed: Field has no WELL_PROFILES entry and no simulator counterpart. Value chosen to match the intended well scenario (e.g. 'worn pump'); not fitted to data.

_schema.oil_max_bpd: Maximum reservoir inflow (bbl/day). Generator: WELL_PROFILES[wid]['oil_max']. Simulator: OIL_MAX_BPD.
_schema.water_cut: Fraction of produced liquid that is water (0-1). Generator: WELL_PROFILES[wid]['water_cut']. Simulator: WATER_CUT_BASE.
_schema.decay_tau: Exponential cooling time constant during production (days). Generator: WELL_PROFILES[wid]['decay_tau']. Simulator: PRODUCTION_DECAY_TAU.
_schema.fillage_cap: Upper bound on pump fillage (%). Generator: WELL_PROFILES[wid]['fillage_cap']. Simulator: clip in compute_fillage().
_schema.motor_base_amps: Baseline motor current (A). Generator: WELL_PROFILES[wid]['motor_base']. Simulator: CURRENT_BASE.
_schema.prod_days_max: Denominator for cycle_prod_progress. Generator: prod_days_range[1] (fixed per well). Simulator previously used observed cycle length — that was the D1 bias. Now uses this value to match generator.

BGW-01._source: generator_default — synthetic_data_generator.py module constants; exactly matches simulator.py module-level constants

BGW-04._source: generator_direct — generate_fleet.py WELL_PROFILES['BGW-04']. NOTE: oil_max=160 was intentionally set to model a high water-cut well with lower hydrocarbon productivity; not fitted to field data.

BGW-05._source: generator_direct — generate_fleet.py WELL_PROFILES['BGW-05']. fillage_cap=65 models worn valves (assumed scenario, not fitted).

BGW-06._source: generator_direct — generate_fleet.py WELL_PROFILES['BGW-06']. oil_max and motor_base match BGW-01 defaults.

BGW-07._source: generator_direct — generate_fleet.py WELL_PROFILES['BGW-07']. oil_max=130 and decay_tau=8 model a depleted well; values are scenario-assumed, not fitted.

BGW-08._source: generator_direct — generate_fleet.py WELL_PROFILES['BGW-08']. fillage_cap=85 and motor_base=28 from generator. gas_multiplier (3x) is a gas-column property not in the simulator; omitted here.

BGW-09._source: generator_direct — generate_fleet.py WELL_PROFILES['BGW-09']. fillage_cap=98 and motor_base=31 from generator.

BGW-10._source: generator_direct — generate_fleet.py WELL_PROFILES['BGW-10']. fillage_cap=97 models recently worked-over pump; scenario-assumed.

BGW-11._source: generator_direct — generate_fleet.py WELL_PROFILES['BGW-11']. fillage_cap=90 is scenario-assumed for a rod-floating risk well.

BGW-12._source: generator_direct — generate_fleet.py WELL_PROFILES['BGW-12']. motor_base=36 models elevated current from maintenance-due equipment; scenario-assumed.
